contracts.signal: Amkor's Investor Day presentation carries a quote from Debora Shoquist, EVP, Operations: 'NVIDIA's pace of innovation depends on a strong ecosystem of partners. Amkor has contributed Advanced packaging solutions that support the performance and reliability of our products.' The quote adds that ongoing investments in the U.S. support a more resilient supply chain and that 'Our work with Amkor and the broader manufacturing ecosystem will advance the future of AI.'

quarterly_data.signal: Amkor's Investor Day 'Advanced Packaging Pipeline' slide prints a table with the headings 'Package Type', '# of Customers' and '# of Engagements' and the rows 2.5D 11, HDFO RDL 5, HDFO Bridge 1 and CPO 3.

Amkor's Investor Day presentation says construction of its Arizona advanced packaging facility began in September 2025 and that Amkor secured an additional 67 acres in May 2026. The Arizona overview slide lists multi-year contracts with top customers and 750K sq ft of cleanroom space; Phase 1 is included in the financial targets and the facility is anchored by key customers, while Phase 2 is not yet included in the financial targets and its timing will be driven by customer commitments. The Arizona financial-framework slide shows 2029 as the estimated break-even and 2030 as the estimated full utilization. The deck also quotes Dr. Kevin Zhang (Senior Vice President, Business Development and Global Sales & Deputy Co-COO) on a slide titled 'Strategic Alignment with the World's Leading Foundry': 'TSMC and Amkor have been long-standing, trusted partners in Asia, and our collaboration in Arizona extends this partnership to the United States.'
quarterly_data.figure: Arizona construction began September 2025; additional 67 acres secured May 2026; 750K sq ft of cleanroom space; estimated break-even 2029; estimated full utilization 2030

quarterly_data.signal: Amkor's Investor Day deck describes a factory network of 13M square feet spanning 9 countries (including the Arizona facility under construction), with South Korea (advanced packaging and R&D center of excellence) expanding its footprint 20% in 2025/26 and Vietnam scaling SiP and memory. The CFO section shows revenue growth of ~10% CAGR 2025–2028 and ~11% CAGR 2028–2030, listing computing drivers as AI training and inference, data routing and networking, and XPU and ASIC solutions.
quarterly_data.figure: 13M square feet across 9 countries; South Korea footprint expanding 20% in 2025/26; revenue ~10% CAGR 2025–2028 and ~11% CAGR 2028–2030
